subject: DocsSprint: maintainers promo allocation & trial extension request
messages:
From: Samira Gomez <samira@codebridge.io>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [OpenDocs] DocsSprint — request for maintainer credits and short trial extension

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking a look — we're running DocsSprint 2027 (virtual, May 20-22). It's an organizer-led sprint for 40+ open-source doc maintainers to update docs, onboarding guides, and contributor flows. Many of the projects are small repos maintained by part-time volunteers. We try to offer compute/credits so maintainers can test locally and run CI tasks during the sprint.

Would Redwood consider: 1) a promo allocation for maintainers (we were thinking 15 x $500 credits), and 2) a short extension to the 30-day trial so that new accounts created for the sprint have 90 days before token limits kick in?

Goals: lower friction for maintainers to try LLM-assisted doc generation and integration into their docs pipelines. We'll list Redwood as a sponsor on the event page and run a short demo slot during the opening.

Attached: DocsSprint-proposal.pdf (high-level program, attendee orgs). Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call.

Best,
Samira
Program Lead, OpenDocs Collective
---
(attachment: DocsSprint-proposal.pdf)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Samira Gomez <samira@codebridge.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [OpenDocs] DocsSprint — request for maintainer credits and short trial extension

Hi Samira — great to hear about DocsSprint, and congrats on the turnout plans.

Short answers: we've supported similar maintainer-focused sprints and I'm confident we can help. Before I lock in specifics, could you confirm two quick things?
1) Expected number of unique Redwood accounts the maintainers will create (approx).
2) Typical workload per maintainer during the sprint (rough token estimate per day or CI job).

My initial proposal internally is: a pool of $7,500 in promo credits (redeemable by approved maintainers), plus a 60-day trial extension for accounts created via the sprint signup link. If your org needs a straight 90-day extension, we can discuss but it requires a short approval loop.

I've CC'd Aditya (sales ops) and Marissa (community programs) to scope the promo mechanics and any co-marketing. If those two are OK, I'll follow up with a short grant letter and claim flow (DocuSign + redeem codes).

Can we schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow? I'm free 10:30-11:30 PT.

Thanks — looking forward,
Kimberly Park
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | kimberly_park@redwood.ai
---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: DocsSprint request — proposed promo allocation

Team — quick internal note on OpenDocs request. Samira asked for 15 x $500 credit slots + 90-day trial extension. Docs attached above. My recommendation: approve a promo pool of $7,500 (flexible to split into 15 $500 codes) and a 60-day extension for sprint-created accounts. Approving 90 days would be fine for high-impact partners but I want to keep credit exposure limited for first-run events.

Operational notes:
- We should use unique promo codes tied to a HubSpot deal (HB-19283) and set redemption to maintainers' verified emails from the OpenDocs attendee list.
- Co-marketing: a short 10-min demo slot during the sprint and a logo on the sponsor page (no paid ad).
- Metrics: ask for a post-event report (counts of redemptions, average tokens used per account, top 3 projects that scaled into heavier use).

Questions for Aditya/Marissa:
- Aditya: any concerns on GAAP recognition / credits accounting for a $7.5k promo?
- Marissa: any community policy conflicts in the way we validate maintainers for the codes?

If you both OK this by EOD Monday, I'll send Samira the grant letter and the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Kim
(Internal)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Samira Gomez <samira@codebridge.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DocsSprint — promo mechanics & grant letter sent

Thanks everyone. Quick update: finance is OK with the $7,500 promo pool as a marketing expense; GAAP note is logged and we will expense against the event budget (GL: 5402).

Kimberly: I generated 15 single-use promo codes tied to deal HB-19283 and created a HubSpot workflow that validates email domains against the attendee CSV. Marissa: grant-letter.pdf attached and I started the DocuSign envelope for signature; Samira you'll receive the DocuSign invite shortly.

Samira — if you can confirm the attendee CSV by end of day Wednesday I'll finalize the redemption list and unlock codes. Also confirming we settled on a 60-day trial extension for sprint accounts.

Best,
Aditya
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
(attachment: grant-letter.pdf)
